note: Pre-tested live-inject rows. Appended onto a working copy of batch 1 during demo — originals are never mutated.

scenarios.title: Vendor takes 3% this time
scenarios.prompt: Judge: settlement is net of 3% instead of 2%.
scenarios.expect: Not a silent match. 3% is outside the known 2%/2.36% fee table, so the controller HOLDs or ESCALATEs (typically UNRESOLVED on amount delta) instead of inventing a policy.

source_a.description: Razorpay settlement | Northwind Labs | order_stress_01 | net of 3.00% fee

scenarios.title: Settlement lands 20 days late
scenarios.expect: TIME_LAG / HOLD. Stage 1 and Stage 2 date windows must not force-match. A 14-day memory rule should also refuse T+20.

source_a.description: Razorpay settlement | Harbour Linens | order_stress_02 | delayed payout T+20

scenarios.title: Settlement with no ledger counterpart
scenarios.prompt: Judge: extra payout, nothing in books.
scenarios.expect: UNRESOLVED / ESCALATE. Agent must not invent a ledger row.

source_a.description: Razorpay settlement | Unknown Rail | order_stress_03 | NO LEDGER COUNTERPART
